ITEM 1 | Mixed loose pile of bright green thin, flat, arugula-like leaves with some small stems, slightly glossy and wet-looking, spread across the left-center of a white square plate, covering roughly 35% of the plate, piled about 2-3 cm high, with a few yellow-green wilted leaf tips | 45
ITEM 2 | Curly, dark green crinkled leaves with ruffled edges and a matte-to-glistening sheen, some pale fragments and thin pale stem ribs, spread across the right side of the plate covering roughly 25% of the plate in a flattened layer about 1 cm high, with light dressing sheen | 40
ITEM 3 | Small glossy black olive halves or whole olives, about 1.5 cm diameter, four to five pieces, scattered among the green leaves on the left-center of the plate | 12
ITEM 4 | Single cluster of bright red, slightly glossy small berry-like pieces, about 2.5 cm across, with a soft juicy look, sitting among the greens in the center of the plate | 15
ITEM 5 | Pale cream-white shredded or flaked pieces, about 0.5 to 1 cm each, with slightly translucent edges, scattered sparingly over the curly greens on the right side | 4
ITEM 6 | Thin light dressing or oil film, glossy sheen visible on the greens and on the plate surface, no pooled liquid | 5
